info.description: Community-maintained, JSON-focused specification for the NHTSA Product Information Catalog Vehicle Listing (vPIC) API. The provider defaults to XML, so these operations require `format=json`. This scope covers VIN, manufacturer, make, model, equipment-code, and vehicle-reference lookups. The Canadian vehicle specifications method is excluded because its data comes from Transport Canada's separate database. NHTSA says no fee, registration, or daily query limit is required; its method page notes that automated traffic controls can still apply to protect the service.
